items.title: Kate Middleton Details Changes After Cancer Battle in Surprise Doc Trailer
items.summary:
Princess Kate Middleton is set to open up about her ongoing cancer recovery in a forthcoming documentary.

“Cancer does change you, it changes your body, it changes you physically,” Kate, 44, began in a trailer for her new Heal documentary released Saturday, November 21. “There’s a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you.”

The Princess of Wales was diagnosed with an undisclosed form of cancer in 2024, subsequently undergoing a preventative round of chemotherapy as treatment. Kate announced in January 2025 that she is in remission , nearly one year before tackling the Three Peaks Challenge mountaineering event in June to raise awareness for cancer treatment and recovery. While completing her trek, Kate secretly filmed Heal .

“Introducing Heal , a deeply personal new documentary from The Princess of Wales, exploring life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness,” an Instagram statement read. “Through this documentary, The Princess hopes to help others navigate diagnosis, recovery and life beyond cancer and transform access to holistic cancer care which supports wellbeing, resilience and quality of life during and after diagnosis.”

Princess Kate Middleton Is ‘In a Positive Place’ After Finishing Chemo 

Kate revealed that all proceeds from Heal will be donated to the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity, which is where she received treatment.

“Is it true when you leave the Royal Marsden, they let you ring the bell?” Kate’s brother, James Middleton , asked in a separate Heal scene mid-hike.…
items.t: Kate Middleton Details Changes After Cancer Battle in Surprise Doc Trailer

items.title: Why ‘Home Alone’ Director Chris Columbus Thinks a Reboot Won’t Work
items.summary:
Original Home Alone director Chris Columbus doesn’t think a reboot of the hit Christmas movie can work without its late star, Catherine O’Hara .

The director shared his opinion about continuing the Home Alone universe with Variety on Friday, November 20 — shortly before reports of a potential Home Alone reboot broke.

“Catherine, as I’ve always said, is 50% of Home Alone ,” Columbus, 68, told the outlet. “There’s the yin and yang of Home Alone : Catherine O’Hara and Macaulay Culkin .”

He further explained, “Without those two in the film, there is no film, because they create the emotional epicenter of that film.”

'Home Alone' Director Chris Columbus Reacts to Catherine O'Hara's Death 

Before he was aware that another Home Alone with Culkin , 46, could be in the works, Columbus added the original cast — as opposed to new actors — would be key to its success.

“I think you potentially could still entertain the idea of doing another Home Alone with the cast,” Columbus added. “Not any of these ridiculous follow-ups to the first. And I only say ridiculous because it’s weird with filmmakers. They don’t understand why that cast works so well. It’s always about the cast. It’s like The Goonies . It’s about the cast.”

However, he still believed the mother-son dynamic between O’Hara and Culkin’s character was crucial.

“It was really about Catherine and Macaulay, if anyone ever wanted to do a sequel and unfortunately that can’t happen now,” he said.

Catherine O’Hara and Macaulay Culkin in Home Alone. (Photo: Everett Collection.) 
 Multiple outlets reported on Friday that Culkin…
items.t: Why ‘Home Alone’ Director Chris Columbus Thinks a Reboot Won’t Work

items.title: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. Find ‘Crazy’ Family Connection
items.summary:
Sarah Michelle Gellar and her husband Freddie Prinze Jr. have more in common than they they bargained for

Speaking to E! News on Friday, November 21, Gellar, 49, revealed the couple recently uncovered a surprising family connection through Ancestry that has them rethinking just how small the world really is.

“We always joke that the closest connection I had to my husband’s side of the family was that for a small time I went to the same high school that my husband’s dad went to, and that was, like, sort of our one thing,” the Buffy the Vampire Slayer alum told the outlet.

She continued, “Then through Ancestry, we found out that our grandparents lived less than two miles away from each other in the Bronx at one point, which they could have potentially known each other. That’s kind of crazy.”

Sarah Michelle Gellar Gushes Over 'Handsome' Freddie Prinze Jr. in Rare Pics 

Although Gellar is a New York native, Prinze Jr., 49, was born in Los Angeles and raised in New Mexico. His late father, comedian Freddie Prinze, was originally from New York, making the family connection even more surprising.

The couple first met while filming 1997’s I Know What You Did Last Summer , but their romance wasn’t immediate. Instead, their relationship began with a series of road trips that ultimately sparked a friendship.

“She didn’t have a driver’s license. She didn’t know how to drive,” Prinze Jr. exclusively told Us in April 2020, recalling how they first connected.

According to multiple reports, jurors convicted former Uber driver Rinderknecht, 30, of igniting a fire on January 1, 2025, that smoldered undetected beneath root systems before reigniting days later on January 7.

The blaze, which became known as the Palisades Fire , tore through the region, leaving widespread devastation and claiming 12 lives. The inferno was one of the most destructive wildfires in California history.

Rinderknecht pleaded not guilty to federal charges of destruction of property by means of fire and arson.

The first charge was narrowed to focus on the January 1 blaze, known as the Lachman Fire, while the second related to the Palisades Fire itself. He was ultimately convicted on both counts.

The Palisades fire verdict comes after prosecutors pursued a retrial following a deadlocked jury in Rinderknecht’s first trial in June. That jury reportedly voted 10-2 in favor of acquittal after two weeks of proceedings, prompting prosecutors to continue building their case.

An aerial view of Malibu beachfront homes that burned in the Palisades Fire. (Photo by Mario Tama/Getty Images)

According to a death certificate obtained by People on Friday, November 20, Johnson’s cause of death is listed as cardiopulmonary arrest, with an underlying cause of metastatic granulosa cell ovarian tumor with peritoneal carcinomatosis.

The National Library of Medicine describes cardiopulmonary arrest as the cessation of adequate heart function and respiration and results in death. Oftentimes, the condition is found in patients with coronary artery disease.

News broke on November 5 that Johnson had died at the age of 59. Family members told TMZ that the actress and model had a “heart event” at her home in Los Angeles on October 27.

Septic shock is the most dangerous stage of sepsis, when an infection triggers a harmful chain reaction in your body, the Cleveland Clinic reports .

Clark’s death certificate also reveals influenza A — or the flu — and chronic alcoholism were all underlying conditions. Acute kidney failure was also listed as a significant contributing factor.

I was a fan before I was a friend. We spoke on the phone three weeks ago. He had us laughing loudly once again.”

Clark’s longtime manager, Barry Katz , also confirmed the news to Us in a statement.

“He was one of the funniest and most talented comedian/actors I have ever had the pleasure of watching,” Katz, 67, shared. “It was an honor to represent him, and he will be missed for the joy, happiness and love he brought to everyone he worked with and the audiences that were blessed to see his undeniable performances.”
